record.question: The following are complications of Diabetes in pregnancy except
record.explanation: Diabetes in pregnancy is associated with miscarriage, infection and polyhydramnios, but tends to cause large-for-gestational-age fetuses rather than intrauterine growth restriction. Option B is therefore the exception. Source: GDMO Gr-III Technical Paper-II (2022), Q66, page 6.
